clusters_read.definition: Clusters for which this instrument has read the table of schools at least once.
clusters_read.label: Clusters with a school table read
clusters_read.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

enr_filed.definition: Schools that have filed their enrolment for the month of the date read.
enr_filed.label: Schools that filed enrolment
enr_filed.source: PM POSHAN daily reporting system, NIC Himachal Pradesh (mdmhp.nic.in)

enr_filed_pct.definition: Schools that have filed their enrolment for the month, as a share of the schools listed. Only these schools can be tested against enrolment.
enr_filed_pct.label: Share that filed enrolment
enr_filed_pct.source: PM POSHAN daily reporting system, NIC Himachal Pradesh (mdmhp.nic.in)

enrolled.definition: The total enrolment of the schools that filed one for the month. Schools that have not filed add nothing to it, so it can fall short of the area's enrolment.
enrolled.label: Enrolment filed
enrolled.source: PM POSHAN daily reporting system, NIC Himachal Pradesh (mdmhp.nic.in)

flag_closed.definition: School-days with meals reported on a weekday the school's own record shows it does not normally serve, or on a date its State's own list marks as a holiday when under 5% of the State's schools reported that day.
flag_closed.label: Meals on a closed day
flag_closed.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

flag_over.definition: School-days on which the meals a school reported exceed the enrolment that school filed for the month.
flag_over.label: Days above filed enrolment
flag_over.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

flag_over_wide.definition: School-days above filed enrolment where the meals are at least 1.2 times the enrolment and at least 5 more than it.
flag_over_wide.formula: meals >= 1.2 x enrolment filed and meals - enrolment filed >= 5
flag_over_wide.label: Days above filed enrolment by a wide margin
flag_over_wide.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

flag_spike.definition: School-days on which a school reported at least 3 times its usual daily count and at least 30 meals more than it. The usual count is the median of its other serving days read.
flag_spike.formula: meals >= 3 x median of other serving days and meals - median >= 30
flag_spike.label: One-day spikes
flag_spike.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

meals.definition: The total of the meal counts schools reported for the date. A school that did not report adds nothing.
meals.label: Meals reported
meals.source: PM POSHAN daily reporting system, NIC Himachal Pradesh (mdmhp.nic.in)

nat_approved.definition: The national system's "No. of Students approved by PAB": the number of children in the State for whom the scheme's Programme Approval Board approved meals for the year. Shown for States only.
nat_approved.label: Children approved
nat_approved.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_enrolled.definition: The national system's "Student Enrolment" for every school it lists in the State or district.
nat_enrolled.label: Enrolment
nat_enrolled.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_holiday.definition: The figure in the national system's "Holiday" column for the date, copied as printed.
nat_holiday.label: Schools on holiday
nat_holiday.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_meals.definition: The national system's "Availed meals": meals the reporting schools said children took on the date.
nat_meals.label: Meals reported
nat_meals.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_meals_pct.definition: Meals reported, per 100 children enrolled in the schools that reported.
nat_meals_pct.label: Meals per 100 enrolled
nat_meals_pct.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_rep_enrolled.definition: Enrolment of the schools that sent a return for the date.
nat_rep_enrolled.label: Enrolment in reporting schools
nat_rep_enrolled.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_reported.definition: Schools the national system counts as having sent a return for the date.
nat_reported.label: Schools that reported
nat_reported.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_reported_pct.definition: Schools that sent a return for the date, as a share of the schools listed.
nat_reported_pct.label: Share of schools reporting
nat_reported_pct.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

nat_schools.definition: The national system's "Total Schools" for the State or district: the schools in its master list.
nat_schools.label: Schools listed
nat_schools.source: PM POSHAN Automated Monitoring System, Ministry of Education (pmposhan-ams.education.gov.in)

reported.definition: Schools that filed a daily meal report for the date.
reported.label: Schools that reported
reported.source: PM POSHAN daily reporting system, NIC Himachal Pradesh (mdmhp.nic.in)

reported_pct.definition: Schools that filed a daily meal report for the date, as a share of the schools listed.
reported_pct.label: Share of schools reporting
reported_pct.source: PM POSHAN daily reporting system, NIC Himachal Pradesh (mdmhp.nic.in)

school_days_tested.definition: Rows of the school tables read in which the school had filed an enrolment above zero and had reported that day. The enrolment test also runs on the months of the schools these tables lead to, which are not counted here.
school_days_tested.label: School-days tested against enrolment
school_days_tested.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

schools.definition: Schools the reporting system lists for the area on the date read.
schools.label: Schools listed
schools.source: PM POSHAN daily reporting system, NIC Himachal Pradesh (mdmhp.nic.in)

schools_flagged.definition: Schools with at least one flag that still stands on the figures as last read.
schools_flagged.label: Schools with a flag
schools_flagged.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

schools_read.definition: Schools named in the school tables this instrument has read. Each is published with the enrolment it had filed and the meals it reported on the latest date read.
schools_read.label: Schools read
schools_read.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

tables_read.definition: Cluster tables of schools read so far, each for one date. A cluster is a group of neighbouring schools, and one table lists every school in it for one day.
tables_read.label: School tables read
tables_read.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

udise_asked.definition: Schools whose code has been looked up in UDISE+, the Ministry of Education's yearly register of schools, after they were flagged on the meal reporting system.
udise_asked.label: Flagged schools looked up in UDISE+
udise_asked.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

udise_category.definition: How UDISE+ records the school: its category, type, management and location (rural or urban). A madrasa or other school with its own calendar may keep working days its State's holiday list does not show.
udise_category.label: Kind of school
udise_category.source: UDISE+ school report card, Ministry of Education (kys.udiseplus.gov.in)

udise_classes.definition: The lowest and highest class the school teaches, as it declared them to UDISE+ for the year shown. The Mid-Day Meal Rules, 2015 cover classes I to VIII, so a school teaching up to class XII has children the Rules do not cover.
udise_classes.label: Classes taught
udise_classes.source: UDISE+ school report card, Ministry of Education (kys.udiseplus.gov.in)

udise_found.definition: Flagged schools for which UDISE+ holds a report card under the code the meal system lists the school by.
udise_found.label: Flagged schools found in UDISE+
udise_found.source: Counted by this instrument from the tables it has read

udise_status.definition: Whether UDISE+ lists the school as operational in the year shown.
udise_status.label: Status in the register
udise_status.source: UDISE+ school report card, Ministry of Education (kys.udiseplus.gov.in)

udise_textbooks.definition: Children in classes I to V (primary) and VI to VIII (upper primary) to whom the school says it gave free textbooks in the year shown. The school files this in its yearly UDISE+ return, outside the meal system. Because it counts the children who received textbooks, it can differ from enrolment.
udise_textbooks.label: Children given free textbooks
udise_textbooks.source: UDISE+ school report card, Ministry of Education (kys.udiseplus.gov.in)
